text.title: FreshDrop team, buyers in Moscow, 3–10 August 2026
text.hypothesis: buyers who miss a slot would pay for a reminder; the reminder feature depends on the answer
text.audience: buyers with 2+ orders in the last 3 months; 1,800 invited, screening: 1 order a week or more
text.channel: email and push; 412 answered (23%); trial run with 20 people
text.q2: How often do you miss a delivery slot?
text.q3: How much would you pay for a fixed slot, rub?
text.q4: Which reminder time do you prefer?
text.c3: a fixed slot is worth paying for
text.gaps: no answers from non-app buyers; no data on the 18–25 group
text.decision: build the reminder first; add a slot guarantee to the next release
text.check: reminder opened by 40% of users in 2 weeks; missed slots down by a fifth
